user.title: Connect to Dockhand
user.description: Enter your Dockhand server URL and settings. An API token will be requested if authentication is enabled in Dockhand.

data.poll_interval: Fast poll interval (seconds) — stats, containers & stacks
data.poll_interval_slow: Slow poll interval (seconds) — images, volumes, networks, schedules

data_description.api_url: The base URL of your Dockhand instance.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to refresh container, stack, and environment stats. Lower values increase load. Default: 60.
data_description.poll_interval_slow: How often to refresh images, volumes, networks, and schedules. Default: 600.
data_description.enable_schedules: Enables sensors for Dockhand maintenance schedules.
data_description.enable_images: Enables sensors for Docker images on each environment.
data_description.enable_volumes: Enables sensors for Docker volumes on each environment.
data_description.enable_networks: Enables sensors for Docker networks on each environment.
data_description.verify_ssl: Uncheck to allow self-signed or untrusted SSL certificates. Only disable if your Dockhand instance uses a self-signed cert.

token.title: Dockhand API Token
token.description: Your Dockhand server requires authentication. Generate an API token in Dockhand under **Profile → API tokens**, then paste it here.

data_description.api_token: A Dockhand API token starting with dh_. Generate one under Profile → API tokens in the Dockhand UI.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Dockhand
reauth_confirm.description: Your API token is no longer valid. Generate a new token in Dockhand under **Profile → API tokens** and enter it below.

data_description.api_token: A Dockhand API token starting with dh_.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dockhand
reconfigure.description: Update server URL and settings. An API token will be requested if authentication is required.
